cohort: 143 individuals born very preterm (<33 weeks of gestation)
finding: Very preterm-born individuals had high levels of ED psychopathology at age 21 years and those with ED psychopathology had smaller grey matter volume in the left posterior cerebellum and smaller white matter volume in the fusiform gyrus bilaterally at age 14/15 years compared with VPT adults with no ED psychopathology.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery predicted engaging in compensatory behaviours.
